scope: time only; top-left triangle / diamond / five-point star; uniform gold template; review drafts

images.name: 初级
images.prompt: Precise additive edit of the supplied approved frameless Minesweeper TIME breakthrough medal. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the EXISTING gold ascending ZIGZAG ARROW, all bends, tip, tail, surrounding angular fragments, gold material, facets, bevel thickness, highlights, perspective, original scale and exact positions. Keep its current square canvas and substantial transparent negative space. The ONLY new element is a SMALL DIFFICULTY EMBLEM in the EMPTY TOP-LEFT corner: center at approximately x=20% and y=21% of the canvas, contained within x=7%..33%, y=8%..34%. It must be visibly separate from the arrow and existing fragments with transparent space around it, never overlapping them. Use ONE emblem occupying about 25% of canvas width and height, matching the existing gold metal with a simple bright face, light upper-left bevel, and dark gold edge facet so its silhouette is clear on both light and dark backgrounds. Keep the emblem secondary to the main arrow; same emblem location, bounding-box size and material across the three difficulty variants. No enclosing medallion, circle, plate, shield, border, corner ribbon, rectangular tag, bars, stripes, characters, letters, numbers or text. Do not introduce any bottom markers. Preserve genuine transparent alpha around and between all elements, no opaque black/white background and no checkerboard baked into pixels. Output ONE isolated full medal, not a comparison sheet. Add this exact top-left emblem: ONE upright equilateral TRIANGLE with three clean straight sides and its apex pointing up. Make it a solid broad triangular metal face with only 2 or 3 restrained bevel facets.
